scope_note: This marks a technical transition in Freud's own 1904 retrospective account; it does not assign a single exact date to a gradual change in practice.
statement: By Freud's 1904 account, his modification of Breuer's cathartic method included giving up hypnosis.
statement_zh: 依 Freud 1904 年的說明，他對 Breuer 宣洩法所作的改變包括放棄催眠。
